chk_foods_nutrition.name: chk_foods_nutrition
chk_foods_nutrition.value:
("foods"."calories_per_100g" is null or "foods"."calories_per_100g" >= 0)
        and ("foods"."protein_per_100g" is null or "foods"."protein_per_100g" >= 0)
        and ("foods"."carbohydrates_per_100g" is null or "foods"."carbohydrates_per_100g" >= 0)
        and ("foods"."fat_per_100g" is null or "foods"."fat_per_100g" >= 0)

chk_nutrition_preferences_budget.name: chk_nutrition_preferences_budget
chk_nutrition_preferences_budget.value: ("nutrition_preferences"."budget_amount" is null and "nutrition_preferences"."budget_period" is null and "nutrition_preferences"."currency_code" is null) or ("nutrition_preferences"."budget_amount" is not null and "nutrition_preferences"."budget_period" is not null and "nutrition_preferences"."currency_code" is not null)

chk_completed_times.name: chk_completed_times
chk_completed_times.value: ("workouts"."status" = 'completed' AND "workouts"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("workouts"."status" = 'in_progress' AND "workouts"."completed_at" IS NULL)
